groups.label: Blooms & accents
groups.blurb: The main flowers and the small accents that fill the gaps between them.

items.role: Large white clusters along the top — the visual main flower.
Mixed-size white rose heads scattered through the spray.
Single garden-rose heads — the round-petal whites.
Layered soft white ranunculus, the small ruffled blooms.
Fluffy fine white misty accent softening the base of every cluster.
Round green button balls dotted through the greenery.
Fine airy strands adding movement and airiness.
Tiny white blooms filling the gaps.
Fine twiggy white branches for the small-flower notes.

groups.label: Trailing strands & foliage
groups.blurb: The trailing strands and foliage — this is what gives the installation its movement and depth.

items.role: The long drooping tassels down the centre — the soul of this arch.
Fine soft trailing branches, thread by thread.
Light airy pinnate leaves for softness.
Dark-green needle tips that carry the outline.
Fluffy massed fine needle leaves filling the base layer.
Spreading fern that shapes the outer edge.
Light yellow-green gradient branches lifting the top layer.
Wide spreading pinnate leaves across the base.
Round-leaf and fine-leaf eucalyptus as the base greenery.
